analogy.rationale: Sigma receptor antagonists act on SIGMAR1 and HTR1A, receptors with limited expression in these cell lines, so transcriptional responses should be weak; the closest analogs are other sigma receptor ligands and GPCR-targeting classes that share overlapping receptor pharmacology but also produce minimal transcriptional changes.
